q1.sampleAnswer: Thanks to them, our planet is not completely covered in trash.

keyPoints.descZh: 多亏他们，地球才没有被垃圾完全覆盖
examples: thanks to them, our planet is not completely covered in trash

q1.rubricZh: 要点：多亏他们，地球没有被垃圾完全覆盖。
q1.explanationZh: 第一段说，多亏清理垃圾的人，我们的星球才没有被垃圾全部盖住，所以他们也是英雄。

evidence.quote: Thanks to them, our planet is not completely covered in trash.

q2.sampleAnswer: He creates beauty out of trash.
q2.explanationZh: 第二段托马斯说，他的工作就是用垃圾创造美。

evidence.quote: My job is to create beauty out of trash.

q3.sampleAnswer: More than 700 students, 100 volunteers and many landfill workers.

keyPoints.descZh: 700多名学生、100名志愿者和许多垃圾填埋场工人
examples: More than 700 students, 100 volunteers and many landfill workers

q3.rubricZh: 要点：学生、志愿者、垃圾填埋场工人三类人。
q3.explanationZh: 第三段列出了参加项目的人：700多个学生、100个志愿者和很多垃圾填埋场工人。

evidence.quote: More than 700 students, 100 volunteers and many landfill workers joined the project.

q4.sampleAnswer: They can use plastic waste to build new plants and animals for “The Future Forest”.

keyPoints.descZh: 为“未来森林”制作新的植物和动物
examples: build new plants and animals for the forest

q4.rubricZh: 要点：为森林制作新植物和新动物。
q4.explanationZh: 第四段说，孩子们可以来工作坊，为森林做新的植物和动物。

evidence.quote: Children can come to my workshop to build new plants and animals for the forest.

q5.sampleAnswer: We should learn to recycle rubbish better and build a brighter future for the world.

keyPoints.descZh: 要学会更好地回收垃圾，为世界建设更美好的未来
examples: learn to recycle it better and build a brighter future for the world

q5.rubricZh: 要点：更好地回收垃圾，建设更美好的未来。
q5.explanationZh: 文章最后一句是托马斯想表达的想法：好好回收垃圾，让世界更美好。

evidence.quote: Let’s learn to recycle it better and build a brighter future for the world!

q6.sampleAnswer: I would want to use plastic waste to create butterflies to put in “The Future Forest”. Firstly, butterflies are beautiful. What’s more, butterflies feed on flowers and fruits, which shows the harmony of nature. (Any reasonable answers are acceptable.)

examples: use plastic waste to create butterflies

keyPoints.descZh: 给出至少两条合理理由
examples: What’s more, butterflies feed on flowers and fruits

q6.rubricZh: 开放题，言之有理即可：写出想做的事，并给出至少两条理由。
q6.explanationZh: 这是开放题：先写你想做什么，再写至少两条理由，用 Firstly、What’s more 连起来。

evidence.quote: Children can come to my workshop to build new plants and animals for the forest.

q7.explanationZh: I’ve ___ forgotten 中间要副词，completely（完全地）合适，意思是完全忘了她的名字。

q8.explanationZh: was 后面接 hiding，was hiding 表示正在躲在沙发下。

q9.explanationZh: 主语 The girl 后面用过去式 covered，意思是她用手捂住了脸。

q10.explanationZh: started 后接 collecting，start doing 是“开始做”，开始收集邮票。

q11.explanationZh: were 后接 filled，be filled with 是“充满”，街上充满了食物的香味。

q12.explanationZh: plans to 后面要动词原形，create more jobs 是“创造更多工作”。

q13.explanationZh: 画线部分是时间，用 When 提问；是过去的事，所以用 did，后面动词用原形 start。

q14.explanationZh: 画线部分是“三吨”，问数量；plastic waste 不可数，所以用 How much。

q15.explanationZh: be filled with 和 be full of 意思相同，都是“充满”。
q15.tipsZh: be full of = be filled with

q16.explanationZh: Let’s 开头的句子，反意疑问句用 shall we。

q17.explanationZh: 先想句子意思：多亏了他们，地球没有被垃圾完全盖住。Thanks to them 开头，the planet is not completely covered in trash。
q17.tipsZh: thanks to 多亏；be covered in 被……覆盖
